description: This file is a C source code for a utility that generates firmware images with specific headers for ZyXEL devices, including checksum calculations, header generation, and image assembly.

methods.name: map_file
methods.description: Maps a file into memory for reading.

methods.name: unmap_file
methods.description: Unmaps a previously mapped file from memory.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: sysv_chksm
methods.description: Calculates a 16-bit System V checksum over data.

methods.name: zyxel_chksm
methods.description: Calculates a checksum suitable for ZyXEL header, converting to network byte order.

methods.name: generate_rootfs_header
methods.description: Generates the root filesystem header with checksum and version info.

methods.name: generate_kernel_header
methods.description: Generates the kernel header with checksum and size.

methods.name: generate_board_header_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum for the board header.

methods.name: generate_board_header
methods.description: Creates the complete board header with checksum and model name.

methods.name: build_image
methods.description: Builds the firmware image by assembling headers and payloads.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the firmware image generation utility.
